item.title: Shizuku Murasaki DLC Release Date Revealed for Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact
item.description: Shizuku Murasaki is officially joining the Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact roster as the third Season 1 DLC character on April 16, 2026.

item.title: Love Live! Hasunosora TV Anime Announced for January 2027 Alongside Upcoming May Movie
item.description: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club is officially getting a TV anime adaptation premiering in January 2027.

item.title: Kantai Collection Developer C2 Kikan Announces Ki-gō Keikaku: 3D Mecha RPG for PC and Mobile
item.description: C2 Kikan (also operating as C2Architecture), the development studio behind the industry-defining mega-hit Kantai Collection, is officially developing Ki-gō Keikaku (Plan Number Ki).

item.title: Gachiakuta: The Game, Combat Trailers, Co-Op Gameplay, and Character Roster Explained
item.description: Com2uS has officially released a series of new combat trailers for GACHIAKUTA: The Game, showcasing the unique, fast-paced fighting styles of playable characters Rudo, Enjin, Riyo, and Zanka.

item.title: Always a Catch! Anime Premiere: Tetsu Inada Joins Cast & Official Theme Songs Revealed
item.description: The highly anticipated fantasy rom-com anime Always a Catch! officially premiered this Wednesday, bringing a fresh twist to the aristocracy genre.

item.title: Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film 6 Teases Massive Plot Twist: Modern Tokyo Appearance & June Release Date
item.description: The highly anticipated sixth film in the Space Battleship Yamato remake series, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), will officially hit Japanese theaters on June 26, 2026.

item.title: 7 Original Dragon Ball Episodes That Are Completely Unhinged Today
item.description: If Dragon Ball Z is the anime equivalent of a blistering, high-octane heavy metal guitar solo, all screaming, lightning, and earth-shattering power, then the very beginning of the original 1986 Dragon Ball series is a guy furiously playing a kazoo while falling down a flight of stairs.

item.title: Kodansha Cancels 'Wishing You Happiness, My Fiancé' Manga After Artist Admits to Plagiarism
item.description: On March 31, Kodansha’s Monthly Shonen Magazine abruptly canceled the manga adaptation of Wishing You Happiness, My Fiancé.

item.title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten Season 2: Release Date, New Cast, and What to Expect
item.description: The wait for more wholesome, sugar-sweet romance is officially over. The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten Season 2 premieres on Friday, April 3, 2026.

item.title: One Piece Episode 1156 Preview: The Straw Hats Finally Arrive in Elbaph (Release Date & Trailer Details)
item.description: The wait is finally over. One Piece Episode 1156 officially marks the end of the anime’s unprecedented three-month hiatus, bringing the Straw Hat Pirates to the highly anticipated land of giants: Elbaph.

item.title: Ruby Hoshino Shines in Stunning New 'Oshi no Ko' x KIYOKO HATA Collaboration Visual
item.description: Strawberry Productions’ brightest star, Ruby Hoshino, has officially crossed over into the real world as the newest advertisement model for the luxury Japanese dress brand KIYOKO HATA.

item.title: The Three Kingdoms of Japan Anime: Release Date, All-Star Cast, and Trailer Details
item.description: The highly anticipated post-apocalyptic political thriller, Nihon Sangoku (The Three Kingdoms of Japan), will officially premiere worldwide on Amazon Prime Video on April 5, 2026.

item.title: Wobble Wobble: The Bird-Based Bomb Disposal Sim Hitting Steam This April
item.description: Indie developer Team Baeb Sae is officially launching Wobble Wobble, a high-tension, physics-based bomb disposal puzzle game, on Steam on April 9, 2026.

item.title: Tokyo Revengers 'Three Deities Arc' Anime: Release Date, New Cast, and Trailer Breakdown
item.description: The wait is officially over for Toman fans. The highly anticipated Tokyo Revengers: Three Deities Arc (officially titled Santen Senso-hen in Japan) will begin broadcasting in October 2026.

item.title: Hideaki Sorachi Returns: Everything We Know About 'Class 2B Hero Destroyers'
item.description: Hideaki Sorachi, the legendary mangaka behind the iconic comedy-action masterpiece Gintama, is officially ending his seven-year hiatus.
